evidence_quote: We reported the first four patients with HA20 with somatic TNFAIP3 mutations.
note: Close call: probands carry somatic (mosaic) TNFAIP3 variants, not germline, but the paper diagnoses HA20 (Table 1 P23-P26); affected children with transmitted variants shown only in pedigrees.
